subject: Retroactive settlement and single-invoice adjustment for FinTrak capacity spike
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fintrak.co>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@fintrak.co>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected Q3/Q4 usage (retroactive) — need settlement

Hi Dylan,

We ran into a billing surprise after our internal audit — FinTrak consumed ~3.1M extra tokens across November that weren't forecast in our committed tier. Procurement asked us to loop you in to discuss a retroactive settlement and to align on a single invoice for the adjustment so we can close our quarter.

Can you share how Redwood typically handles these retroactive spikes? Specifically:
- A concise calculation of the one-time charge (showing committed vs billed).
- Whether you can consolidate into a single adjustment invoice for our AP team.
- Any potential credit or pro-rated protection given our expansion conversation for next year.

Attaching our internal usage snapshot for the weeks in question — happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Lee
Head of Cloud Ops | FinTrak Analytics
[attachment: fintrak_internal_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]

From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fintrak.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected Q3/Q4 usage (retroactive) — need settlement

Hi Hannah — thanks for the note and the snapshot. Sorry you hit this — we saw the same spike on our side (large burst from several inference jobs).

Quick reply with next steps:
- I attached a proposed settlement calculation that shows committed vs actual token usage and a line-item one-time invoice amount. (See attached: usage_report_Q3-Q4.csv and proposed_settlement_term.pdf)
- We can issue a single invoice dated Nov 30 for the adjustment and mark it as a one-time true-up to simplify your AP flow.
- Given your ongoing expansion talks, I can propose a 10% one-time concession on the true-up if you sign the SOW addendum by Dec 10 — this yields a clean path for both teams.

Can you confirm if a Nov 30 invoice works for AP? If yes, I’ll work with Vivek to finalize the numbers and Monica to prepare the addendum.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: usage_report_Q3-Q4.csv (CSV, 120KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 11:21:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: Unexpected Q3/Q4 usage (retroactive) — need settlement

Circling internal owners — Vivek, can you confirm the invoice amount in the CSV and whether finance is okay with applying a 10% concession (sales-approved one-time credit) tied to SOW addendum signature?

Also tagging Rishi for renewal cadence — we should roll the addendum into the renewal conversation so FinTrak understands the capacity uplift and committed tier for 2026.

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Unexpected Q3/Q4 usage (retroactive) — need settlement

Monica/Dylan — I validated the numbers in usage_report_Q3-Q4.csv and produced an approved settlement figure: $18,750 before any concession.

- Applying the 10% concession reduces it to $16,875.
- Finance is comfortable issuing a single adjustment invoice dated Nov 30 if procurement confirms that is acceptable for FinTrak AP.
- We will include an itemized breakdown on the invoice and a note referencing deal FTK-2024-EXP-77 and the signed addendum.

I will prepare the invoice and the credit memo placeholder; Dylan, loop me into the addendum signature when ready so we can reconcile immediately.

Vivek
Sr. Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed_settlement_term.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fintrak.co>, Procurement Team <procurement@fintrak.co>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintrak.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Final invoice path and addendum for approval — FinTrak one-time settlement

Hi Hannah and team —

Thanks for confirming that a single invoice dated Nov 30 works for AP. To recap and next steps:

1) Settlement amount (post-concession): $16,875.
2) Invoice: Redwood will issue one adjustment invoice on Nov 30 with an itemized breakdown.
3) Addendum: Monica attached the SOW addendum; if you can review and sign by Dec 10 we will apply the 10% concession.

Please find the addendum attached for signature. If everything looks good I can route the DocuSign link. If you prefer an internal PO first, let me know and we’ll accommodate.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: signed_addendum_SOW.docx (DOCX, 75KB)]

From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fintrak.co>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@fintrak.co>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final invoice path and addendum for approval — FinTrak one-time settlement

Dylan/Monica — thanks for the clear summary. We received the invoice this morning and I see the adjustment charge (matches the post-concession figure).

Two quick notes:
- We routed the DocuSign to our legal team this afternoon; target signature by Dec 9.
- Our AP asked if you can include the HubSpot ticket reference on the invoice (they need it for our ledger). HubSpot ID: FTK-77.

Once the addendum is signed we’ll process the payment within our standard 30-day terms. Appreciate the flexibility here — getting this in one invoice made closing the quarter much simpler.

Regards,
Hannah
Head of Cloud Ops | FinTrak Analytics
